segments.name: Industrial products
segments.description: The company sells industrial products to business customers through its platform, product sales and marketplace models, in China and overseas.
segments.evidence: The Group engages primarily in the business-to-business trading and services of industrial products through its platform.

revenueModel.text: Business customers pay the company for industrial products and for fulfillment and after-sale services provided under its product sales and marketplace models.
revenueModel.evidence: Customers under our marketplace model still have the same access to our fulfillment services and after-sale services.
